manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{U}, plus an additional {1} available if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
description:
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Homarid Spawning Bed by paying {1}{U}{U} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, creating seven token copies of Scholar of the Ages.
Each of the newly created Scholar of the Ages tokens triggers, returning Mystic Reflection and up to thirteen other instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Scholar of the Ages tokens, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
